gaps.title: Auto-regressive decoding forces sequential generation
gaps.description: Transformer decoding produces one token at a time, so inference latency scales with sequence length regardless of how much parallel hardware is available. Non-autoregressive methods trade quality for parallelism and no method recovers auto-regressive quality at a fixed small number of steps.

gaps.title: Non-autoregressive machine translation lags on long outputs
gaps.description: Reported speedups on WMT En-De largely vanish for long outputs, where the number of refinement passes needed grows with the target length.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: Introduces the Transformer; decoding is auto-regressive with masked self-attention.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.summary: Iterative denoising over continuous data with a fixed forward noise schedule.

ideas.title: Kernelized Attention with Differentiable Spectral Filters
ideas.description: Replaces the scaled dot-product compatibility function with a learnable kernel parameterized as a spectral filter bank, for sub-quadratic long-context attention.

user_input: I care most about whether the speedup survives on long outputs.
